title: CounterFactual Retrieval (CFR)
description:
Code for CounterFactual Retrieval for Evidence-Aware Individual Animal Identification, accepted at WACV 2027. The repository provides foreground-mask generation, retrieval evaluation, and experiment configurations. The cfr-sam3-masks package provides the updated mask extractor; evaluation workflows are provided as scripts.

Foreground masks are available separately at CFR Wildlife Masks. Source images and model weights are obtained separately.
